script: Most people think saving money starts with cutting coffee. Wrong. It starts with one rule: fifty, thirty, twenty. Fifty percent of your income covers needs. Rent, groceries, bills. Thirty percent goes to wants. Yes, wants. You're allowed to live. And twenty percent goes straight to savings before you touch anything else. But here's the part nobody mentions. The rule fails if you apply it to your gross income. Use your after-tax number, or the math silently breaks. One more trick: automate the twenty percent on payday. If it never hits your checking account, you never miss it. Try it for one month. Most people find money they didn't know they had. Follow for more rules that actually work.
